title: Railway Project & Business Management

canonicalTerminology.definition: Project governance defines decision rights, accountability, controls and reporting arrangements used to direct and oversee a project.

claims.text: Railway projects and businesses must integrate technical scope, stakeholders, schedule, cost, risk, quality and regulatory obligations rather than treating them as independent workstreams.
claims.applicabilityNote: Level-neutral educational statement; adapt depth without changing the canonical fact.

visualSpecs.purpose: Show integrated railway project governance dimensions.

prohibitedUnsupportedClaims: Do not invent contract requirements, approvals, budgets, performance guarantees or regulatory status.
Do not present classroom business cases as approved project governance.
